text.en: Today, the words “Aboriginal peoples” name three separate groups: First Nations, Inuit and Métis. Each one is a people of its own.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, l'expression « peuples autochtones » désigne trois groupes distincts : les Premières Nations, les Inuit et les Métis. Chacun est un peuple à part entière.

text.en: In the Inuktitut language, the word Inuit means “the people.”
text.fr: En inuktitut, le mot Inuit veut dire « le peuple ».

source.quote: The Inuit, which means “the people” in the Inuktitut language

verification.evidence: The Inuit, which means “the people” in the Inuktitut language

text.en: The Inuit know the land, the sea and the animals well. That knowledge let them live in one of the hardest places on earth.
text.fr: Les Inuit connaissent bien la terre, la mer et les animaux. Ce savoir leur a permis de vivre dans l'un des milieux les plus rudes de la planète.

source.quote: Their knowledge of the land, sea and wildlife enabled them to adapt to one of the harshest environments on earth.

verification.evidence: The Inuit, which means “the people” in the Inuktitut language, live in small, scattered communities across the Arctic. Their knowledge of the land, sea and wildlife enabled them to adapt to one of the harshest environments on earth.

text.en: Most Métis live in the Prairie provinces.
text.fr: La plupart des Métis vivent dans les provinces des Prairies.

source.quote: the majority of whom live in the Prairie provinces.

verification.evidence: The Métis are a distinct people of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry, the majority of whom live in the Prairie provinces.

text.en: The Métis have a dialect of their own. It is called Michif.
text.fr: Les Métis ont leur propre dialecte. Il s'appelle le michif.

verification.evidence: The Métis are a distinct people of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry, the majority of whom live in the Prairie provinces. They come from both French- and English-speaking backgrounds and speak their own dialect, Michif.

text.en: Of the three groups, First Nations people are the largest. The Métis come next, and the Inuit are the smallest.
text.fr: Des trois groupes, les Premières Nations sont le plus nombreux. Les Métis viennent ensuite, et les Inuit sont le groupe le moins nombreux.

source.quote: About 65% of the Aboriginal people are First Nations, while 30% are Métis and 4% Inuit.

verification.evidence: About 65% of the Aboriginal people are First Nations, while 30% are Métis and 4% Inuit.
